title: Lunar Relay
summary: A palm-sized all-printed desk mechanism: press either cratered moon and the opposite moon rises through its guarded lunar well.
interaction: A central rocker transfers one downward press into an equal and opposite rise. Release or press the raised moon to reset.
assembly: Align the axle tab with the horizontal keyways, pass it through base-rocker-base, then rotate it one quarter-turn so the far tab is captive.
use: Set the base on a level desk and press only the top face of either moon. Keep fingertips out of the side gaps while it moves.
limitations: Digital geometry checks do not prove a successful print, physical fit, wear life, or cycle count.
The specified free-fit clearances are an FDM starting point and may need calibration for a particular printer and material.
This is a desk object for ages 14 and up, not a product for small children.
